_comment_motm: How Manager of the Month is scored. 'net' subtracts transfer hits (matches how the league table works). 'gross' ignores hits. FPL's own MOTM uses net.
_comment_prizes: Set these once. Leave amounts at 0 until you've agreed the pot - the site shows 'TBC' for anything at 0. currency is a symbol.
_comment_cup: FPL creates mini-league cups automatically. Set cup_start_event if you know it; null means 'read it from the API when it exists'.
_comment_months: Months to publish. A gameweek belongs to the calendar month of its DEADLINE (Europe/London). That gives Aug=GW1-2, Sep=GW3-5, Oct=GW6-9 for 2026/27. Override here only if FPL publishes a different split.
